pro_course_detail.title: Chat With Me- Conversation Practice For Kids
pro_course_detail.description:
This course focuses on enhancing children's speaking and listening skills through engaging conversations. This course offers opportunities to build a rich vocabulary, enhance listening skills, master pronunciation, and develop reading proficiency. As we delve into stories matched to your child's skill level, we'll engage in meaningful conversations about the narrative. I'll encourage them to share their own experiences and pose comprehension questions to enhance their conversational skills. To ensure comprehension, I'll employ techniques such as Total Physical Response (gestures), modeling, and physical props.

Beginner:
Piggie and Gerald stories by Mo Willems
Intermediate:
Stories by Robert Munsch
Advanced:
Harry Potter, Diary of a Wimpy Kid, and more.

pro_course_detail.description: Focus on pronunciation, listening, vocabulary, conversational skills, reading, writing and grammar. Suitable for beginner through advanced students.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description: Focus on improving conversation, speaking and listening skills. Suitable for beginner through advanced students.

pro_course_detail.title: *NEW* Accent Reduction & Pronunciation
pro_course_detail.description: These lessons focus mainly on reducing accent and improving pronunciation. We will recite poems, monologues, songs, work on individual sounds, stress and the rhythm of the English language.
